fields.Name: T086 - Entity Form FK Search Inline Create-New Footer
fields.Description: Targets the CanCreateFK create-new footer inside the FK search dropdown — a distinct permission-gated affordance separate from the search itself and from the New-Record button on the grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Event Registrations' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, open a record's full form, and click Edit to enter edit mode. Click a foreign-key field (e.g. 'Member') and type a value unlikely to match anything (e.g. 'ZZQX Nonexistent'). At the bottom of the FK search dropdown a sticky 'Create new...' footer button (with a plus icon), prefilled with the typed text, should appear. Success is seeing that 'Create new' footer render (you do NOT click it), OR — if the current user lacks create permission on the related entity — the footer being deliberately absent while the dropdown still shows a no-match state. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing a non-matching value in a foreign-key field renders the FK search dropdown

A 'Create new...' footer button with a plus icon appears at the bottom of the dropdown, prefilled with the typed text (OR is deliberately absent when the user lacks create permission on the related entity)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
